roles.title: Operational Analyst
roles.description: Operational analytics and reporting, plus GTM and revenue operations automation with Clay, HubSpot CRM and n8n for lead enrichment, prospect segmentation and CRM synchronization.
highlights: Developed a centralized Power BI dashboard tracking 20+ operational KPIs across project delivery, resource utilization, client performance and financial operations, reducing reporting effort by 35%.
Streamlined SQL and ETL workflows to consolidate project, timesheet, client and financial data from 5+ internal sources into standardized operational reporting.
Implemented an AI-powered text-to-SQL solution so stakeholders can retrieve operational insights in natural language, with automated regression testing through Hermes to validate query accuracy.
Analyzed utilization, capacity, SLA performance and budget variance across 15+ client engagements using Power BI, DAX and Power Query.
Automated recurring reporting and data quality validation with Python, SQL, Power Query and Excel, reducing reporting turnaround by 4 hours.

roles.title: Data Scientist II
roles.description: Owned the inventory lifecycle of 12 active models, with status updates to internal stakeholders and bank partners within 24 hours of any model change. Coordinated third-party validation against SR-26-2 and OCC-11-12 and facilitated fair lending reviews.
highlights: Automated variable stability (PSI) and performance (AUC, KS, lift) tracking for 10 active models via parameterized Jupyter notebooks and a Snowflake-to-Power BI pipeline, reducing execution time by 95%.
Designed ad-hoc views for charge-off benchmarking, roll-rate analysis and re-parameterization comparisons, driving pre-rollout lift analysis that reduced the delinquent population by 60%.

Enhanced an automated lookup query that retrieves underwriting data by application ID on API-flagged fund/no-fund conflicts, using Claude for query refinement and cutting manual investigation time by 85%.
Built a fact-and-dimension database architecture from scratch to replace a retiring Tableau/SaaS reporting system, with a scalable schema for current and future credit risk and response models.
Standardized the model development lifecycle, replacing email-based reviews with structured leadership alignment meetings and reducing turnaround time by 75%.

roles.title: Data Analyst Intern
roles.description: Analytics and data engineering internship on healthcare data, covering Snowflake, Power BI, PySpark and Databricks.
highlights: Tracked client feasibility requirements in JIRA and wrote Snowflake stored procedures that optimized execution time and space by 25%.
Optimized the Power BI data structure to reduce report load time by 30%.
Identified 5 key business metrics with a cross-functional team and ran hypothesis testing on patient data, improving treatment success rate by 20%.
Used PySpark to manage and update NLP pipelines for EHR data, and Databricks and R for cleaning and ETL on Census API socio-economic data, reducing null values by 30%.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Data integration, root cause analysis and predictive modeling on academic performance and lecture data.
highlights: Integrated data from multiple sources using Apache Airflow and AWS S3 and redesigned API services for greater scalability, reducing manual effort by 50%.
Implemented Random Forest and KNN models for student performance prediction, achieving an average precision of 92% and recall of 89%.
Performed ETL with pandas and optimized SQL scripts, increasing data access speed by 67%.
Ran root cause analysis with regression and correlation analysis to identify factors affecting test scores.
Built a Python YouTube scraper that collected 10K links and titles for a specific keyword.
